name: Twilio
one_liner: Cloud communications platform offering APIs for SMS, voice, email, verification and customer engagement.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic with API key SID/secret (or Account SID/Auth Token); OAuth 2.0 also offered per first pass (not re-verified).
access_notes: Free trial without credit card: 100 SMS, 75 voice minutes etc, expires after 30 days; trial messaging limited to verified numbers. Production is pay-as-you-go (US SMS $0.0083/segment); US A2P 10DLC registration requires a paid account.

official_sdks: server-side SDKs in many languages (list not verified)

buildability.rationale: Self-serve credentials and broad documented REST API with OpenAPI spec, but trial is time-limited and production messaging needs a paid account plus regulatory registration (A2P 10DLC, toll-free verification).

evidence.quote: You can sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card.
To complete A2P 10DLC registration, you must have a paid Twilio account.
Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication. Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
MCP Server for all of Twilio's Public API

disputes.why: Trial is 30-day limited free units; production use is pay-as-you-go and 10DLC needs paid account.
Paid account and messaging compliance registration needed for real use; trial restricted to verified recipients.
